notes: UTM publishes postgraduate entry rules on admission.utm.my (university-wide CPA table for coursework and mixed mode, English page) and on faculty sites. Programmes whose own page states no rule cite the admission.utm.my shared pages (international postgraduate section lists them as coursework or mixed mode); the CPA rule and English scores there are university-wide. Applicants below the English score may still enrol after UTM's Intensive English Programme or ELS CIEP. Skipped: research degrees, ODL (odl.utm.my) copies, Doctor of Professional Practice, dual/joint degrees (UTM-Kyushu, UTM-Pusan, UTM-Yamaguchi, UTM-Tsukuba, Meiji), Education mixed-mode specialisations, and the humanities.utm.my programme pages (robots.txt). The admission fee/PDF guidelines were not read. No application deadlines were quoted: no page states a dated closing day.

academic.text: Bachelor's degree with CPA 4-scale 2.50 or higher (or equivalent: 3.13/5, 62.5%), no working experience needed; below 2.50 needs 5 years' related working experience (UTM master by coursework, general rule)
academic.quote: Obtained Bachelor degree with the following grade First Class Second Class Upper Second Class Lower Excellent Pass Scale Working Experience CPA Scale of 4 2.50 or higher No Working Experience Needed

ielts.quote: International English Language Testing System IELTS (ACADEMIC) Required band and score Admission Status / Decision Overall band 6.0 Student can enroll at Faculty

toefl.quote: TOEFL (TOEFL iBT/ TOEFL iBT HOME EDITION) Required band and score Admission Status / Decision Overall Score 60 Student can enroll at faculty
